summary: Layer 1B expanded the defense-subtier supplier universe with one reference anchor and three underfollowed US-listed candidates. The strongest underfollowed fit is Ducommun because filings show high aerospace/defense revenue concentration, defense-space backlog growth, and exposure to military/space platforms. Astronics is a lower-attention aerospace/defense electronics and test-systems supplier with a possible certification/test-gate angle. AAR is a second-order sustainment and parts-distribution candidate tied to government and defense customers. Curtiss-Wright is included only as a reference anchor because its defense electronics, naval, and engineered-component exposure maps the upper-tier version of the same bottleneck, but its market cap and visibility make it less suitable for the underfollowed lane.
